memory.northbank/csv-export-format: Northbank CLI refunds_csv (and any future CSV export) uses a hand-rolled minimal escaper in cli.py csv_field(), not the stdlib csv module. Contract: quote a field only if it contains a comma, double quote, CR, or LF; double embedded double quotes; LF line endings with one final LF; empty result is header "id,posted_at,amount_cents" plus LF. Rationale: csv.writer with lineterminator="\n" does not quote fields containing CR (stdlib quotes only delimiter/quotechar/chars-in-terminator), and its excel dialect emits CRLF, so both violate the contract. Rows come from provider.LedgerLake.list_transactions, which already returns posting-instant-then-ID order; posted_at strings are emitted verbatim (offsets preserved). Established in trial-74w.
